notes: Standard-tier list prices, USD per 1M tokens, read from developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing on 2026-10-09 (fetched twice, rows matched). gpt-5.3-codex comes from the page's Specialized models section.
Codex reports cached_input_tokens and cache_write_input_tokens as subsets of input_tokens; the adapter maps them to cacheRead and cacheWrite5m and bills the rest of input_tokens as input.

OpenAI has one cache TTL per model (30m for GPT-5.6 and later), not Anthropic's 5m/1h pair, so both write columns hold the same rate. GPT-5.6 and later charge cache writes at 1.25x uncached input (developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching). GPT-5.5 and earlier have no write premium, so their write columns equal the input rate.
longContext applies above 272K input tokens per request (the page says: 'Long context: >272K input tokens').

fast holds the page's Fast-mode rates (renamed from Priority on 2026-07-30), applied when Codex reports service_tier fast or priority. The page lists no Fast cache-write rate, so it is 1.25x Fast input for GPT-5.6 and later, which is how the Standard and Batch tables are built, and equals Fast input for gpt-5.5 and gpt-5.3-codex. The page also lists Fast long-context rates; core applies Fast short-context rates to every Fast request, so a Fast request above 272K is under-priced.
The Ultrafast tier (gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol), Batch/Flex rates and the 10% regional-processing uplift are not represented. Codex rollouts never report regional processing.
webSearchPerRequest: web search costs $10.00 per 1k calls; search content tokens are billed at model rates and are already in the usage counts.

Unpriced on purpose, because there is no official API list price: gpt-reserve (Codex's reserve fallback allowance once plan limits run out), codex-auto-review (the Guardian approval reviewer). gpt-5.3-codex-spark, gpt-5-codex, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-max, gpt-5.1-codex-mini, gpt-5.2-codex and codex-mini-latest are not on the current pricing page either. All of them are priced at $0 and listed in unpricedModels. Third-party calculators quote prices for some of them; those are not used.
Only exact model ids are listed, no prefix keys. A prefix such as gpt-5-* would price gpt-5-codex at gpt-5 rates, which would be a guess.
GPT-5.6 Sol's price is promotional, 'available at least through November 21, 2026' per the pricing page. Re-check after that date.
